experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Here, we used the A549 human diploid lung adenocarci-noma cell line (alveolar, type-2) in proliferating or bleomycin-induced senescent states, to ex-plore their responses to a severe proteotoxic stress with the proteasome inhibitor bortezomib (100 nM for 24 hours) at the total and poly-ubiquitylated proteome levels.

number_of_fractions.evidence: For total proteome digests, 10 µg of peptides were labelled with 50 µg of TMTpro reagent, separated into 12 peptide fractions, and 4 µL of the 30 µL from each fraction analysed by LC-MS.
For poly-ubiquitylome digests, all peptide material was labelled with 25 µg of TMTpro reagent, separated into 4 peptide fractions, and 6 µL of the 15 µL from each fraction analysed by LC-MS.
